title: Commvault Announces AI Recovery for AI Vulnerabilities
summary: Our announcements at SHIFT 2026 reveal how we’re delivering continuous recovery for the AI era.
body_markdown:
##### [Commvault Gives IT and Security an AI Agent Recovery Plan – Helping Recover Agents and Unwanted Changes Triggered Across Environments](https://www.commvault.com/news/ai-agent-recovery-plan)


Commvault, a leader in delivering continuous recovery for the AI era, today announced new AgentRecover capabilities designed to help organizations audit agent activity, restore agents, and recover the data and systems they affected across environments. With support for Amazon Bedrock AgentCore and Microsoft Foundry, Commvault is extending full-stack recovery across supported AI agents and the enterprise systems they interact with.

##### [Commvault Announces Strategic Partnership with Zscaler to Help Enterprises Adopt AI with Confidence, Control, and Resilience](https://www.commvault.com/news/strategic-partnership-with-zscaler)


Commvault announced a strategic partnership with Zscaler, the cybersecurity platform for the AI era, that will help customers adopt AI with confidence and control while also being able to rollback and recover from harmful agentic activity. The partnership aims to bring together a host of complimentary capabilities. Zscaler Security for AI solutions identify the use of AI applications in the enterprise and enforce policy on what users and AI agents can do. Commvault’s AI and cyber resilience capabilities help enterprises recover their data, applications, and identities following attacks, disruptions, or outages.


##### [Commvault to Help Enterprises Put More Data to Work Safely for AI with NVIDIA](http://commvault.com/news/work-safely-for-ai-with-nvidia)


Commvault announced a collaboration with NVIDIA that will help enterprises make more of their data usable for AI while keeping data current, authorized, and governed as it flows into AI applications and agents. By combining NVIDIA NIM microservices and NVIDIA NemotronRetriever with


[Commvault Data Activate](https://www.commvault.com/solutions/data-activate) , the companies will help organizations put more enterprise data to work for AI, keep AI data current and authorized, and preserve accountability from source to use.


##### [Commvault Redefines Recovery in the AI Era: From Restoring Data to Restoring the Business](https://www.commvault.com/news/commvault-recovery-studio)


Commvault announced Commvault Recovery Studio, a new approach to enterprise recovery that will use precise automation to bring back the business, not just recover data. It will orchestrate the recovery of applications, identities, configurations, infrastructure dependencies, and datasets together in an automated, runbook-driven workflow to help organizations resume business operations fast.
